description: This is a PHP class that extends AbstractBuzzVideoURL to extract embedded Vimeo video URLs from Vimeo links. It defines methods to identify and convert Vimeo URLs to embedded player URLs, using regex patterns.

classes.name: EmbeddedURLForVimeo
classes.description: A class that processes Vimeo URLs to retrieve embedded Vimeo video URLs.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Returns the embedded Vimeo URL if the input URL is a Vimeo URL; throws an exception otherwise.
